newsitem.title: CHINA: Shell in China contract for offshore exploration.
newsitem.headline: Shell in China contract for offshore exploration.

text.p: Shell Exploration (China), a subsidiary of Royal Dutch/Shell, signed a contract on Friday with the China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC) to explore for oil and gas in the South China Sea.
The block lies in the Pearl River basin, about 100 km southeast of Hong Kong and covers an area of 800 square km, the Xinhua news agency quoted a CNOOC official as saying.
Under the terms of the contract, Shell will undertake the investment risk alone and take charge of drilling exploratory wells and geological appraisal work, he said.
Shell has cooperated with CNOOC since 1979 and undertaken several projects in the South China Sea, northern Bohai sea and the East China Sea, Xinhua said. It gave no more details.
